verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents its own terminal emulation and supported control sequences, and full-screen TUI apps work in it (Neovim synchronized rendering; htop over SSH once the terminfo docs are followed). That implies tmux can run inside it, but no evidence names tmux directly, and a user wishing for tmux -CC support suggests there is no native control-mode integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on reports of tmux running in Ghostty, a native tmux integration/control mode (tmux -CC), and documented handling of TERM/terminfo for tmux over SSH.
